import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill missing Sleep Disorder with 'None'
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Split Blood Pressure into Systolic and Diastolic columns
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set a professional and visually appealing style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create a 2x2 figure to display multiple facets of the data
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Analysis of Sleep and Health Metrics', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Quality vs. Duration, colored by Sleep Disorder
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Quality of Sleep',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Stress Level',
    sizes=(150, 450),
    alpha=0.8,
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    palette={'None': 'g', 'Sleep Apnea': 'r'}
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Duration by Disorder and Stress', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Quality of Sleep (Scale)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (Hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Sleep Disorder & Stress')

# Plot 2: Cardiovascular Health Indicators by BMI Category
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Systolic',
    y='Heart Rate',
    hue='BMI Category',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(150, 450),
    alpha=0.8,
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    palette={'Normal': '#3b528b', 'Overweight': '#21918c', 'Obese': '#fde725'}
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Cardiovascular Health by BMI and Activity', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='BMI & Activity Level')

# Plot 3: Distribution of Daily Steps by Occupation
sns.stripplot(
    data=df,
    x='Occupation',
    y='Daily Steps',
    hue='Occupation',
    s=15,
    jitter=0.1,
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    legend=False
)
sns.boxplot(
    data=df,
    x='Occupation',
    y='Daily Steps',
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    showfliers=False,
    boxprops={'facecolor':'None', "zorder":10},
    whiskerprops={'linewidth':2, "zorder":10},
    zorder=10
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Daily Steps Distribution by Occupation', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

# Plot 4: Relationship between Stress Level and Sleep Quality
sns.violinplot(
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    inner='quartile',
    ax=axes[1, 1]
)
sns.stripplot(
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    color='black',
    s=8,
    alpha=0.7,
    ax=axes[1, 1]
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sleep Quality Across Stress Levels', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Stress Level (Scale)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (Scale)', fontsize=12)


# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
